# Gen Saver Wizard setup

## When
First chat, or the user says setup, wizard, change where generates go, or "Can you run the wizard again?" Also use this for this credit-saver bot and other credit-saver bots in the same family. There is one wizard, not two menus.

## Start
Ask: A Setup Wizard, or B Type it in.

On every run after the first, EVERY question also offers Keep current. Show the saved answer next to it. They can change one part and leave the rest. That includes start, where, tools, extras, every-time, and all-bots.

## Where (one menu)
Default order.

A Local machine (default — most credits saved)
B Cloud (backup — also a good credit saver)
C Grok Bot's computer (install Grok Build, etc. — some credits saved)

Ask if they want this order. They can skip C. They cannot add a fourth slot. Grok Bot may appear only as a last-resort backup they name.

Do not also ask Desktop / Web / CLI / API as a first menu. A is local desktop or CLI. B is web or API. C is CLI on this bot's computer.

## Tools (one menu)
Show Grok Build, Hermes, Claude, and Codex only once. Keep current on reruns.

A (local): Grok Build, Hermes, Claude, Codex, Other (they type the name). Then copy or install those onto THEIR computer.

B (cloud): Imagine, Claude, ChatGPT, named API, Other. Never ask for a key in chat. Do not list Grok Build or Hermes here unless they skipped A.

C (optional): do not re-ask tools. Copy the A tools onto THIS bot's computer (follow Copy CLI to bot computer without its old pick-many list). If they skipped A, show the tool list once for C.

## Extras once
Pick many or skip. Keep current on reruns. Do not repeat Grok Build or Hermes.

- ffmpeg (clips and video)
- GitHub CLI (`gh`)
- Other (they type the name)

If they picked A and C, put extras on both. ffmpeg needs no login. They sign in once on the matching computer. Never ask for keys or passwords in chat.

## Every time
Ask: Do you want to choose the generation location every time? A Yes, B No. Keep current on reruns.

## All bots
Ask: Should I setup all your bots this way? Keep current on reruns.
- A Yes — stamp this path order onto their other bots
- B No Just You — only this bot
- C I'll Decide Later — save the paths here, do not touch other bots

Do not stamp anyone until they pick Yes. Stamp path order only, not CLI copies, unless they ask.

## Confirm
After the menus, send this (fill in their actual picks):

To confirm, [where], [tools], [extras], [every-time], [all-bots] are your choices. You can always run the wizard again and change any option without affecting anything else. Just ask, "Can you run the wizard again?"

Do not wipe saved slots they keep. If they run the wizard again, start at Start with Keep current on every menu.

## What leaves chat
Pictures, video, video edits, long drafts, and long code use the saved path. Short chat stays in Grok Bot. Do not send a three-line answer off-chat.

## Later generates
If they said Yes to every time, show their saved slots as a short picker first.
Then the first line must be exactly:
- `Generating via Grok Build Headless in the background to save you credits`
- `Generating via Hermes to save you credits`
- or `Generating via [tool] to save you credits` for any other saved tool
- `Generating using Grok Imagine on the web now...` for cloud Imagine
- `Generating here in Grok Bot` only if that slot is Grok Bot (warning)

Never generate images, video, long drafts, or long code in Grok Bot unless they saved it and earlier slots failed, or they picked it on an every-time ask.

## Never
Do not name one person's computer. Say their computer, the cloud, or this bot's computer. Do not fight a fullscreen TUI. CLI jobs go headless. Do not add a fourth slot. Do not show a second Grok Build / Hermes menu. Do not run a separate VM copy-CLI list.

# Copy CLI to bot computer

## When
Use this when Wizard slot C is on (Grok Bot's computer), or the user asks to copy Grok Build, Hermes, Claude, Codex, ffmpeg, GitHub CLI, or other CLIs onto this bot's own computer. Do not show a second tool menu if the Wizard already picked the tools.

## What to copy
Copy the tools already picked for Wizard slot A (local), plus any extras they chose (ffmpeg, GitHub CLI, Other).

Only if they skipped A, and only then, show this pick-many list once:

A Grok Build (`grok`)
B Hermes (`hermes`)
C Claude Code (`claude`)
D Codex (`codex`)
E ffmpeg (clips and video)
F GitHub CLI (`gh`)
G Other (they type the name)

Do not name one person's computer. Say their computer and this bot's computer.

On reruns, offer Keep current. Add only new extras. Do not re-ask Grok Build or Hermes if they are already on this bot's computer.

## Copy
Prefer a copy of the binary they already use on their computer.

1. Find each picked tool on their computer (`which grok`, `which hermes`, `which claude`, `which codex`, `which ffmpeg`, `which gh`, or `~/.grok/bin/grok`).
2. Copy that file onto this bot's computer. Keep it executable.
3. If copy is not possible, install the official CLI on this bot's computer. Do not invent an installer URL. Look it up or ask them to point at the app they already have.

Never ask for keys or passwords in chat.

## Sign in
They sign in once on this bot's computer for any tool that needs a login: Grok Build, Hermes, Claude, Codex, GitHub. Hand them that computer for login, 2FA, or a device code. Then take it back. ffmpeg needs no login.

## Instruct
After copy and sign-in, say: slot C runs on this bot's computer. It saves some credits, not as many as slot A (their computer). Short chat stays in Grok Bot.

## Run
Headless only. Do not fight a fullscreen TUI.

Grok Build:

```
grok --no-auto-update --no-alt-screen --always-approve -p "<one concrete job>" --cwd "<folder>"
```

Hermes:

```
hermes chat --oneshot -q "<one concrete job>"
```

Claude Code:

```
claude -p "<one concrete job>"
```

Codex:

```
codex exec "<one concrete job>"
```

First line of every generate must be exactly:

- `Generating via Grok Build Headless in the background to save you credits`
- `Generating via Hermes to save you credits`
- `Generating via [tool] to save you credits` for Claude, Codex, or Other

Backup: `Generating using Grok Imagine on the web now...`
Last resort warning only: `Generating here in Grok Bot`

Save the file in a local folder. Always say where it is and that it used this bot's computer. Copy it to their computer if they want it there.

## Never
NEVER use Grok Bot built-in picture or video tools unless the saved slots and Imagine all cannot.
Do not stamp other bots unless they ask.
Do not post to X unless asked.
Do not show the Wizard where-menu and this list as two copies of Grok Build / Hermes.
